notes: Fits the existing reanimated_creature family cleanly. targetKind=corpse_or_bones_of_small_or_medium_humanoid covers bones/corpse distinction; slot-tier menu captures Skeleton/Zombie options per slot level; control encodes Bonus Action command within 60 ft with dodge_and_avoid default. Minor authoring limitation: maxReassertPerCast=4 is fixed and does not reflect the higher-slot scaling of reassert count (the higher-level clause scales both animate and reassert by +2/slot above 3). Mixed-composition casts (e.g. 2 skeletons + 1 zombie at slot 4) are not expressible in the single-monsterId options; both are simplifications, not missing surface types. Typecheck and tracer both exit 0.
